title: Ship Frames
description: Required design choice. The superstructural skeleton that gives a ship its basic profile.

options.name: Sturdy
options.description: Built to last in a place of temporary things; helps weather strong assaults.

options.name: Moulded
options.description: A single unbroken structure running through the ship, a feat of safety-conscious engineering.

options.name: Light
options.description: Made with the lightest possible materials in the smallest possible amounts.

options.name: Sleek
options.description: Runs low to the waves and is hard to spot.

options.name: Flexible
options.description: Multi-segmented or jointed for adjustability and responsiveness.

options.name: Scything
options.description: Often wedge or blade-shaped, constructed to cut as efficiently as possible.
